EFS/S06.title: Generate is blocked exactly when today's pre-round has not been saved cleanly, both contexts (seeded rows A–E)
EFS/S06.detail: Local QA stack on main 43c38a4f (round-companion-wt-qa, web :6473, Convex :4510); fresh @roundai.test physician per test; every ai/* action the page sent was answered or refused at the browser socket (pre-support.ts aiSocket: anything unscripted is refused), so no model ran; tripwire around every batch: 'no model call'. Spec newspec-c/pre-efs-s06-gate-rows.spec.ts, one seeded chart per row as the matrix's S06 seed; each Encounter tab only read (no action sent). Judged 12/13: row A failed summary (Hospital and Nursing Home) — disabled, 'Today's pre-round did not finish processing … Tap Save Note to retry before generating.'; row C edited after processing — disabled, 'The pre-round text was edited … Tap Save Note so the panels match'; row D clean (both modes) — enabled, no message. Failed 1: row B (preRoundProcessing left set, nothing running) — disabled, but the screen says 'Today's pre-round is still being processed. Wait for the panels, then generate.', not to tap Save Note, while the Pre-Round tab of the same chart says 'structured processing was interrupted. Tap Save Note to continue.' (TC-10/S29 a). Recorded (Q10): row E, no pre-round today — enabled. Gate code (src/domain/status.ts) unchanged since e02167f. Known: B27.
EFS/S06.productIssue: A chart whose Save Note was cut off (the processing flag is still set but nothing is running) tells the physician on the Encounter tab to wait for the panels, which never come, while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note.
